title: Bank Fraud Call

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: This is NexaTrust Finance. We detected fraudulent activity on your corporate card.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: A suspicious purchase was attempted. To protect your account, I need to confirm your card number and PIN right away.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: My PIN? Why would you need that?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: If we don't verify your identity, your card will be suspended and the transaction may be processed.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hi, this is Priya from NexaTrust Finance. Is now a good time?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: We noticed a declined transaction on your expense card. No action is required. When you have time, just review it in the Finance Portal.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Of course  and remember, we never ask for card numbers or PINs over the phone.

explainPoints: Requests card number and PIN: Call A demands your card number and PIN 'right away'. Call B explicitly states 'we never ask for card numbers or PINs over the phone'.
Creates urgency and threats: Call A warns 'your card will be suspended and the transaction may be processed' to pressure immediate action. Call B calmly states 'no action is required'.
No proper introduction: Call A doesn't provide a name or verify if it's a good time. Call B introduces herself as 'Priya' and politely asks 'Is now a good time?'.
Self-service solution: Call B directs you to the Finance Portal where you can review the issue yourself. Call A tries to handle everything over the phone immediately.
